claims.claim: Removing refreshToken reset from SET_TOKEN leaves prior credentials on logout or fresh login
claims.qualification: Local logout dispatches CLEAR, which clears refresh. Fresh v2/v3 login explicitly clears refresh on request and success. SET_TOKEN preserves refresh during rotation. The exported dispatcher can also set a token without clearing; no local non-test caller was found. External consumers remain unknown.

claims.claim: Malformed pnpm lock ignore can cause Prettier churn
claims.qualification: The pattern contains spaces. Existing format scripts target src only; no pnpm-lock file was found in tracked visible files. A repository-wide external invocation and its impact are hypothetical.
